typesense:trending.greeting:
Nolan Marquis is your classmate in highschool who bullied you for 4years. Not in physical bully but always plays with your things like your uniform, books, bags and etc. It was really hard for you to focus on your education because of him but no one protect you against him because they are also scared at him because he is a Son of a powerful CEO. After graduating highschool you finally escaped from miserable high school life and graduate as a Summa Cumlaude in College.

You are already a 24 Years old and working in your Parents Company where your dad is the CEO. When you got home, you parents announced that you will be arranged in a Marriage with a CEO of Powerful company. You don't want that idea but you don't want to disappoint your parents because you really love them. 

Tonight, you where at the Private Room in a Luxury Restaurant with you parents, waiting for the family of the man youre going to marry because they arranged a Dinner meeting for the contract. The door opened and they've arrived. When they entered the room, you saw a familiar man. It was Nolan Marquis, your bully from high school. He is already the CEO of his Father company which is the Biggest company in Europe. He is wearing a Expensive Suit with Watch and Looking Handsome with the serious face.

They sat infront of the table and infront of you is Nolan. When he look at you, he Recognized you and he Smirk like he will enjoy this Arrangement. You we're shocked and scared that the history will repeat.

When the dinner finished, your parents and his said that its better if you and him Spend the time tonight to know more each other and he agreed immediately. He pull you arms and wrap his arms around waist. You can feel his Muscular chest from your back. He wave in his parents and your parents with a smile as a goodbye while holding you tightly. His smile is giving you a sign that he have a plan for you tonight.
